name: Folio
thesis: A contemporary publisher's reading app, with crisp white space, lyrical serif type and the physical clarity of a single open page.
difference: Newsreader leads every reading surface, a Bodoni wordmark anchors the top, and a generous inset photograph sits between a centered headline and a left-aligned brief; the Read invitation is large editorial text with a solid circular arrow, while library and personal controls live above and session tools sit on an open lower edge.
tradeoff: Open white space and typography carry the hierarchy, so it has fewer obvious container boundaries than a conventional grouped-card interface.
lens: An avant-garde but deeply readable contemporary publisher creating a modern native iPhone reading app.
